data.narrative:
Flamefront Propulsion is a pre-seed stage propulsion company in the Defense & Security sector, founded by Matt Garcia, an MIT aeronautics specialist and former founding engineer and head of propulsion at Mach Industries. The valuation universe consists of 10 comparable companies: 2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms, including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Saronic, and Quantum-Systems.

A peer-median approach is not applicable in this instance. The Defense & Security sector contains 22 same-sector peers overall, but the narrow filters for pre-seed stage, adjacent stage, and similar valuation tier yielded insufficient data—zero same-stage comparables, one adjacent-stage comparable, and zero similar-tier companies. This subset falls below the minimum three-datapoint threshold required for reliable median estimation. Applying an all-sector median would introduce material bias and is therefore not recommended.

The analysis cannot produce a triangulated valuation range without additional data on revenue, growth rates, or financing multiples from the public and private peer set. Key uncertainties include whether adjacent-stage or broader Defense & Security multiples apply to pre-seed propulsion technology, the relevance of public defense contractors to early-stage private firms, and Flamefront's differentiation relative to competitors in propulsion systems. Further data collection on peer financing rounds and revenue multiples is necessary before a defensible range can be established.
